item: Hosted API on Fly and Neon
evidence: The owner selected GitHub Pages with a recorded demo; Docker and local SQLite/PostgreSQL API configuration are included.
API tests read corrections through independent connections, reject writes without a token, and verify transaction rollback.
Six rules have clean, defect, and empty-input tests and injected positive test cases; the scorecard reports precision/recall with intervals and TP/FP/FN/TN.
Per-population and per-field calibration includes imperfect validation variants; reliability shows test results, distinct parent-page counts, and intervals.
Validation selects the threshold; test reports review/error rates with intervals and undefined conditional rates remain unavailable.
packages/classify and the manifest confusion matrix; the miscellaneous class uses generated letter tokens.

status: Done for all generated test parents
evidence: Every generated test document is evaluated at five preselected levels per type; six small-multiple charts show both backends, intervals and measured floor crossings.
The canonical experiment uses simulated validation corrections; the optional API consumes accepted persistent corrections.
web includes inbox, reviewer, trace, evaluation, report, lab, rules, models, and browser SQL with local practice state.
scripts/render_reports.py renders complete files and a deliberate mutation test rejects publication drift.
Architecture, definitions, serving/privacy/runbook, dated decisions, and three evidence notebooks with rejected shortcuts.

Python tests exceed the coverage floor; strict mypy, Ruff, report drift, actual theme contrast, executed notebooks, and browser tests are enforced by the Pages workflow. Commit history records substantive changes; a target commit count is not manufactured.
